description: This file contains test cases for the stream mode and streaming configuration functions used in Slack integration. It tests functions like resolveSlackStreamMode, resolveSlackStreamingConfig, applyAppendOnlyStreamUpdate, and buildStatusFinalPreviewText to ensure correct behavior under various scenarios.

methods.name: resolveSlackStreamMode
methods.description: Resolves the stream mode based on input, defaulting to 'replace' and accepting specific string values.

methods.name: resolveSlackStreamingConfig
methods.description: Generates the streaming configuration object based on various input parameters, including legacy and unified modes.

methods.name: applyAppendOnlyStreamUpdate
methods.description: Updates the streaming text state by appending incoming chunks, maintaining previous state, and detecting changes.
